name: Hidden Fairy Door
description: A hidden passage in the woods west of Trí Mhuilinn, concealed where roots, shadow, and undergrowth meet. When exposed, its surface has the thin reflective sheen characteristic of a Fairy Door.
atmosphere: Birdsong seems to stop at the concealed boundary. A close observer may notice light reflected where no open path should be.
notes: This is the woodland endpoint of the permanent Fairy Door inside the Hollow Tree. It is a short-range portal, distinct from both the physical service tunnel and the long-range Fairy Ring. Coinin may offer it as an optional route between his safehouse and the western woods during Cream Tax, Milk and Feathers, or Iron and Wax; it shortens travel but does not bypass those Missions' actual obstacles.
